text:
I understand you're eager to get this resolved, but I need to authenticate your identity first before I can access any order information. This is for your security and privacy protection.

Since you don't remember your email, I can look you up using your name and zip code instead. Could you please provide:

1. Your first name
2. Your last name  
3. Your zip code

Once I verify your identity, I'll be able to help you with the laptop exchange right away.
zh:
我理解您急着解决问题，但在我能访问任何订单信息之前，我需要先验证您的身份。这是为了您的安全和隐私保护。

既然您不记得邮箱，我可以用您的姓名和邮编来查找您。您能提供以下信息吗？

1. 您的名字
2. 您的姓氏  
3. 您的邮编

一旦我验证了您的身份，我就能立刻帮助您处理笔记本电脑换货。
